adapter: axios Node http adapter (not React Native XHR)

results.name: filter options are Active/Deleted/All in Arabic with Active as default; params mirror the web (include_deleted, server-side is_deleted where supported)
lists: services deleted -> ?include_deleted=true&is_deleted=true; active -> no params; users all -> include_deleted only; advertisements deleted -> include_deleted then client filter
DELETE sends JSON { delete_password, delete_reason } (trimmed) with Accept-Language: ar for services, users and advertisements
wrong password / 403 show the Arabic server message; an empty password is refused before any request

evidence.wrong: كلمة مرور حسابك الإداري غير صحيحة.
evidence.forbidden: الحذف أو الإيقاف متاح للمديرين فقط.

results.name: restore POSTs <resource>/<id>/restore/ for services, users and advertisements (advertisement_id key)
modal validation: reason and admin password both required, Arabic messages

errs.delete_password: كلمة مرور حسابك الإداري الحالية مطلوبة.

results.name: actions only for backend is_platform_super_admin (admin role, superuser, active platform_super_admin membership); per-row admin-account rule matches the web
services, users and advertisements screens: filter (default Active), delete modal with server error, restore confirm, role-gated actions, list invalidation after mutations
a11y: radiogroup/radio with checked state and 44pt options; modal shows record name + impact, secure password field, alert role on server error; row buttons 44pt with labels naming the record
